clickPower.name: Click Power
clickPower.about: Each tap counts as this many hits

earnings.name: Earnings
earnings.about: Multiplies the squares you earn from mining a new block

defense.name: Defense
defense.about: Others need this many times the hits to take your blocks

growth.name: Growth
growth.about: How many new map blocks appear when you mine a new block

factorySpeed.name: Factory Speed
factorySpeed.about: How fast your factories mine, compared with a base player (0.05 = 1/20)

factoryLifetime.name: Factory Lifetime
factoryLifetime.about: How long a factory works after you wake it up

factoryYield.name: Factory Yield
factoryYield.about: Squares a factory earns per block it mines, never more than the block's normal pay

glossary.name: Base blocks
glossary.meaning: How many blocks a map starts with. Fixed forever once the map is created
glossary.formula: Chosen at creation; default defaultBaseBlocks

glossary.name: Level
glossary.meaning: A map's difficulty, 1 to 10. Each map has its own
glossary.formula: L = 1 + floor(log2(mined / E + 1)), at most maxLevel

glossary.name: Blocks mined
glossary.meaning: Every new block first claimed on that map, by players and factories
glossary.formula: Counts up by 1 per first claim

glossary.name: Level start
glossary.meaning: Blocks mined on a map when level L begins

glossary.name: Terrain factor
glossary.meaning: How hard the terrain is: sand 0.5, grass 1, forest 1.5, stone 3, gold 1. Water can't be claimed

glossary.name: Hardness
glossary.meaning: Hits to mine a block. A block keeps the level it was born at
glossary.formula: H = hitsPerBlock x 2^(L-1) x t

glossary.name: Click Power
glossary.meaning: Hits each tap counts as
glossary.formula: Tier value

glossary.name: Defense
glossary.meaning: Multiplies the hits others need to take your block
glossary.formula: Hits to take = H x D (+ walls)

glossary.name: Pay
glossary.meaning: Squares for mining a new block. Taking an owned block pays nothing
glossary.formula: S = H / hitsPerSquare x M_earn + G

glossary.name: Earnings
glossary.meaning: Multiplies pay
glossary.formula: Tier value

glossary.name: Gold bonus
glossary.meaning: Extra squares for first claiming a gold block

glossary.name: Work-hour
glossary.meaning: One hour of base mining. The unit every price is measured in
glossary.formula: 1 Wh at level L = W(L) squares

glossary.name: Work index
glossary.meaning: Squares one work-hour is worth at level L
glossary.formula: W(L) = (3600 / baseBlockSeconds) x 2^(L-1) = 1,200 x 2^(L-1)

glossary.name: Payback hours
glossary.meaning: How long an object takes to repay its price

glossary.name: Value per hour
glossary.meaning: Work-hours an object gives (or forces an attacker to spend) per hour

glossary.name: Universal price
glossary.meaning: The price of anything with a V
glossary.formula: Price = P x V x W(L)

glossary.name: Tier
glossary.meaning: Upgrade tier, 1 to 10. Tier 1 is open from the start; each tier is bought in S small steps
glossary.home: Each player; Upgrades tab Steps per tier

glossary.name: Tier range
glossary.meaning: What an upgrade gives at the start and the end of tier N. Every tier max is the last one times the multiplier
glossary.formula: lo_1 = Tier 1 start; lo_N = Tier 1 max x m^(N-2); hi_N = Tier 1 max x m^(N-1)

glossary.name: Value after step s
glossary.meaning: Big gains on the first steps, flattening toward the tier max
glossary.formula: lo_N + (hi_N - lo_N) x ln(1 + g x s / S) / ln(1 + g)

glossary.name: Price of step s
glossary.meaning: Cheap at first, then rising and flattening toward the end of the tier
glossary.formula: T x W(N) x ln(1 + c x s / S) / sum of ln(1 + c x j / S) for j = 1 to S

glossary.name: Tier cost
glossary.meaning: Work-hours to buy all of one tier's steps, priced at that tier's level
glossary.formula: T x W(N) squares

glossary.name: Tier in use
glossary.meaning: Your upgrades work at most up to the level of the block you act on
glossary.formula: min(your tier, the block's level)

glossary.name: Factory price
glossary.meaning: Price of your nth factory
glossary.formula: P_F x V_F x W(L) x g^(n-1)

glossary.name: Factory hits
glossary.meaning: Hits a factory adds per second
glossary.formula: (hitsPerBlock / baseBlockSeconds) x Factory Speed value

glossary.name: Factory distance
glossary.meaning: Extra hits when a factory's target lies outside its home square (d = blocks outside it)
glossary.formula: d x factoryDistancePenaltyWh x W(L) x hitsPerSquare

glossary.name: Wall strength
glossary.meaning: Hits to break a wall
glossary.formula: w x H

glossary.name: Wall price
glossary.meaning: Price of one wall; the same for every wall in a batch
glossary.formula: wallPriceWh x W(L of the block) x max(1, sqrt(walls you own on this map) / 2)

glossary.name: Skin price
glossary.meaning: Price of a skin
glossary.formula: rarity hours x W(L)

glossary.name: Market fee
glossary.meaning: Share of each land sale destroyed
glossary.formula: price x marketFee
